title: 解码方法数
description: 数字字符串按 A=1、B=2、…、Z=26 解码，输出共有多少种解码方式。

solutions.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
s = data[0]
n = len(s)
d = [0] * (n + 1)
d[0] = 1
d[1] = 0 if s[0] == "0" else 1
for i in range(2, n + 1):
    if s[i - 1] != "0":
        d[i] += d[i - 1]
    v = int(s[i - 2:i])
    if 10 <= v <= 26:
        d[i] += d[i - 2]
print(d[n])
